thandriyaina dhevuniyandunu prabhuvaina yesukreesthu nandunu unna thessaloneekayula sanghamunaku paulunu, silvaanunu, thimothiyunu shubhamani cheppi vraayunadhi. Krupayu samaadhaanamunu meeku kalugunu gaaka.

viswaasamutho koodina mee panini,prematho koodina mee prayasamunu,mana prabhuvaina yesukreesthunandali nireekshanatho koodina mee orpunu, memu mana thandriyaina devuni yeduta maanaka gnaapakamu chesinonuchu,maa prarthanaalayandu mee vishayamai vignaapanamu cheyuchu.
mee andari nimitthamu ellappudunu dhevu niki kruthagnathaasthuthulu chellinchuchunnaamu.

yelayanagaa dhevunivalana premimpabadina sahodarulaaraa, meeru erparachabadina sangathi, anagaa maa suvaartha, maatathoo maatramugaaka shakthithoonu, parishuddhaatmathoonu, sampoorna nishchayathathoonu meeyoddhaku vachiyunna sangathi maaku teliyunu.
mee nimitthamu memu meeyedala ettivaaramai yuntimo meereruguduru.
parishuddhaatmavalana kalugu aanandamuthoo goppa upadravamandu meeru vaakyamu nangeekarinchi, mammunu prabhuvunu poli naduchukoninavaaraithiri.
kaabatti maasidoniyalonu akayalonu vishvaasulandarikini maadhiriyaithiri; endukanagaa meeyoddhanundi prabhuvu vaakyamu maasidoniyalonu akayalonu mrogenu;
akkadamaatrame gaaka prathi sthalamandunu dhevuniyedala unna mee vishvaasamu velladaayenu ganuka, mememiyu cheppavalasina avashyamuledu.
meeyoddha maaketti praveshamu kaligeno, akkadi janulu mammunugoorchi teliya jeppuchunnaaru. Mariyu meeru vigrahamulanu vidichipetti, jeevamugalavaadunu satyavanthudunagu dhevuniki daasulagutakunu,

dhevudu mruthulalonundi lepina yesu, anagaa raabovu ugrathanundi manalanu thappinchuchunna aayana kumaarudaina yesu, paralokamunundi vachunani yeduru choochutakunu, meerelaagu dhevuni vaipunaku thirigithiro aa sangathi vaare teliyajeyuchunnaaru.
sahodarulaaraa, meeyoddha maa praveshamu vyarthamu kaaledu gaani
meereriginatte memu philippeelo mundu shramapadi avamaanamupondi, yenthoo poraatamuthoo dhevuni suvaarthanu meeku bodhinchutakai mana dhevuniyandu dhairyamu techukontimani meeku teliyunu.
yelayanagaa maa bodha kapatamainadhi kaadu, apavitramainadhi kaadu, mosayukthamainadhi kaadugaani

suvaarthanu maaku appaginchutaku yogyulamani dhevunivalana enchabadina vaaramai, manushyulanu santhooshapettuvaaramu kaaka mana hrudayamulanu pareekshinchu dhevunine santhooshapettu vaaramai bodhinchuchunnaamu.
meererigiyunnattu memu icchakapu maatalanainanu, dhanaapekshanu kappipettu veshamunainanu ennadunu viniyogimpaledu; induku dhevude saakshi.
mariyu memu kreesthuyokka aposthalulamai yunnanduna adhikaaramucheyutaku samarthulamai yunnanu,meevalanane gaani yitharula valanane gaani, manushyulavalana kalugu ghanathanu memu koraledu.
ayithe sthanyamichu thalli thana sontha biddalanu gaaravinchunatlugaa, memu mee madhyanu saadhuvulamai yuntimi.
meeru maaku bahu priyulaiyuntiri ganuka meeyandu visheshaa peksha galavaaramai dhevuni suvaarthanu maatramu gaaka maa praanamulanukooda meekichutaku siddhapadiyuntimi.

avunu sahodarulaaraa, maa prayaasamunu kashtamunu meeku gnaapakamunnadhi gadaa. Memu meelo evanikainanu bhaaramugaa undakoodadani raatrimbagallu kashtamuchesi jeevanamu cheyuchu meeku dhevuni suvaartha prakatinchithimi.
memu vishvaasulaina meeyeduta entha bhakthigaanu, neethi gaanu, anindyamugaanu pravarthinchithimo daaniki meeru saakshulu, dhevudunu saakshi
thana raajyamunakunu mahimakunu mimmunu piluchuchunna dhevuniki thaginattugaa meeru naduchukonavalenani memu meelo prathivaanini heccharinchuchu, dhairyaparachuchu saakshyamichuchu,
thandri thana biddala yedala naduchukonureethigaa meelo prathivaaniyedala memu naduchukontimani meeku teliyunu.

aa hethuvuchethanu, meeru dhevunigoorchina varthamaana vaakyamu maavalana angeekarinchinappudu, manushyula vaakya mani yenchaka adhi nijamugaa unnattu dhevuni vaakyamani daanini angeekarinchithiri ganuka memunu maanaka dhevuniki kruthagnathaasthuthulu chellinchuchunnaamu. aa vaakyame vishvaasulaina meelo kaaryasiddhi kalugajeyuchunnadhi.

avunu sahodarulaaraa, meeru yoodayalo kreesthu yesunandunna dhevuni sanghamulanu poli naduchukonina vaaraithiri. Vaaruyoodulavalana anubhavinchinatti shramale meerunu mee sonthadheshasthulavalana anubhavinchithiri.
aa yoodulu thama paapamulanu ellappudu sampoorthi cheyutakai prabhuvaina yesunu pravakthalanu champi mammunu hinsinchi,

anyajanulu rakshanapondutakai vaarithoo memu maatalaadakunda mammunu aatankaparachuchu,dhevuniki ishtulu kaanivaarunu manushyulakandariki virodhulunai yunnaaru; dhevuni ugratha thudamutta vaarimeediki vacchenu.
sahodarulaaraa, memu shareeramunubatti koddi kaalamu mimmunu edabaasiyunnanu, manassunu batti meedaggara undi, migula apekshathoo mee mukhamu choodavalenani mari yekkuvagaa prayatnamu chesithivi.
kaabatti memu meeyoddhaku raavalenani yuntimi;paulanu nenu palumaaru raavalenani yuntini gaani saathaanu mammunu abhyantharaparachenu.
yelayanagaa maa nireekshanayainanu aanandamainanu athishayakeereetamainanu edi? Mana prabhuvaina yesuyokka raakada samayamuna aayana yeduta meere gadaa.
nishchayamugaa meere maa mahimayu aanandamunai yunnaaru.
kaabatti ika sahimpajaalaka ethensulo memontigaa nainanu unduta manchidani yenchi,

yee shramalavalana evadunu kadhilimpabadakundunatlu mimmunu sthiraparachutakunu, mee vishvaasavishayamai mimmunu heccharinchutakunu, mana sahodarudunu kreesthu suvaartha vishayamulo dhevuni pari chaarakudunaina thimothini pampithivi. Memu meeyoddha unnappudu,
manamu shramanu anubhavimpavalasiyunnadani meethoo mundhugaa cheppithivi gadaa? aalaage jariginadhi. Idi meekunu teliyunu;
atti shramalanu anubhavinchutaku manamu niyamimpabadina vaaramani meereruguduru.
induchetha nenunu ikanu nahimpajaalaka, shodhakudu mimmunu okavela shodhinchenemo aniyu, maa prayaasamu vyarthamai poyenemo aniyu, mee vishvaasamunu telisikonavalenani athani pampithini.

thimothiyu ippudu mee yoddhanundi maayoddhaku vachi,memu mimmunu elaagu chooda napekshinchuchunnaamo aalaage meerunu mammunu chooda napekshinchuchu, ellappudunu mammunu premathoo gnaapakamu chesikonuchunnaarani, mee vishvaasamunu goorchiyu mee premanu goorchiyu santhooshakaramaina samaachaaramunu maaku tecchenu.
anduchetha sahodaru laaraa, maa yibbandi anthati lonu shrama anthatilonu mee vishvaasamunu chuchi mee vishayamulo aadharana pondithivi.
yelayanagaa, meeru prabhuvunandu sthiramugaa nilichithiraa memunu bradhikinatte.
memu mee mukhamuchuchi mee vishvaasamulo unna lopamunu theerchunatlu anugrahinchumani raatrimbagallu atyadhikamugaa dhevuni vedukonuchundagaa,
mana dhevuniyeduta mimmunubatti memu ponduchunna yaavatthu aanandamu nimitthamu dhevuniki thaginattugaa kruthagnathaasthuthulu elaagu chellimpagalamu?
mana thandriyaina dhevudunu mana prabhuvaina yesunu mammunu niraatankamugaa meeyoddhaku theesikoni vachunu gaaka.
mariyu mana prabhuvaina yesu thana parishuddhulandarithoo vachinappudu, mana thandriyaina dhevuni yeduta meehrudayamulanu parishuddhatha vishayamai anindyamainavigaa aayana sthiraparachutakai,
memu meeyedala elaagu premalo abhivruddhipondi vardhilluchunnaamo, aalaage meerunu okani yedala okadunu manushyulandari yedalanu,premalo abhivruddhipondi vardhillunatlu prabhuvu dayacheyunu gaaka.
mettuku sahodarulaaraa, memu prabhuvaina yesu dvaaraa meekichina aagnanu meereruguduru.

kaagaa meerelaagu naduchukoni dhevuni santhooshaparachavaleno maavalana nerchukonina prakaaramugaa meeru naduchukonuchunnaaru. ee vishayamulo meeru anthakanthaku abhivruddhi nondavalenani mimmunu vedukoni prabhuvaina yesunandu heccha rinchuchunnaamu.
meeru parishuddhulagutaye, anagaa meeru jaaratvamunaku dooramugaa undutaye dhevuni chitthamu.
meelo prathivaadunu, dhevuni erugani anyajanulavale kaamaabhilaashayandu kaaka,
parishuddhathayandunu ghanathayandunu thana thana ghatamunu etlu kaapaadukonavaleno adhi yerigiyundutaye dhevuni chitthamu.

ee vishayamandevadunu athikraminchi thana sahodaruniki mosamu cheyakundavalenu; endukanagaa memu poorvamu meethoo cheppi saakshyamichina prakaaramu prabhuvu veetanniti vishayamai prathidandana cheyuvaadu.
parishuddhulagutake dhevudu manalanu pilichenugaani apavitrulugaa undutaku piluvaledu.
kaabatti upekshinchuvaadu manushyuni upekshimpadu gaani meeku thana parishuddhaatmanu anugrahinchina dhevunine upekshinchuchunnaadu.
sahodhara premanugoorchi meeku vraayanakkaraledu; meeru okani nokadu preminchutaku dhevuni chethane nerpa badithiri.
aalaagunane maasidoniya yandanthata unna sahodarulandarini meeru preminchuchunnaaru. Saho darulaaraa, meeru premayandu mariyokkuvagaa abhi vruddhinonduchundavalenaniyu,
sanghamunaku velupativaari yedala maryaadagaa naduchukonuchu, meekemiyu koduva lekundunatlu memu meeku aagnaapinchina prakaaramu meeru parulajoliki poka,
mee sonthakaaryamulanu jarupukonuta yandunu mee chethulathoo panicheyutayandunu aashakaligi yundavalenaniyu, mimmunu heccharinchuchunnaamu.
sahodarulaaraa, nireekshanaleni yitharulavale meeru duḥkhapadakundu nimitthamu, nidrinchuchunnavaarini goorchi meeku teliyakunduta maakishtamuledu.
yesu mruthi pondi thirigi lechenani manamu namminayedala, adhe prakaaramu yesunandu nidrinchinavaarini dhevudaayanathoo kooda ventabettukoni vachunu.
memu prabhuvumaatanu batti meethoo cheppunadhemanagaa, prabhuvu raakadavaraku sajeevulamai nilichiyundu manamu nidrinchinavaarikante mundhugaa aayana sannidhi cheramu.
aarbhaatamuthoonu, pradhaanadoothashabdamuthoonu, dhevuni boorathoonu paralokamunundi prabhuvu digivachunu; kreesthunandundi mruthulaina vaaru modata lethuru.
aa meedata sajeevulamai nilichiyundu manamu vaarithookooda ekamugaa prabhuvunu edurkonutaku aakaashamandalamunaku meghamulameeda konipobadudumu. Kaagaa manamu sadaakaalamu prabhuvuthoo kooda undumu.
kaabatti meeru ee maatalachetha okaninokadu aadarinchukonudi.
sahodarulaaraa, aa kaalamulanugoorchiyu aa samayamulanugoorchiyu meeku vraayanakkaraledu.
raatrivela donga elaagu vachuno aalaage prabhuvu dinamu vachunani meeku baagugaa teliyunu.

lokulu nemmadhigaa unnadhi, bhayamemiyuledani cheppukonu chundagaa, garbhinistreeki prasavavedhana vachunatlu vaariki aakasmikamugaa naashanamu thatasthinchunu ganuka vaarentha maatramunu thappinchukonaleru
sahodarulaaraa, aa dinamu dongavale meemeediki vachutaku meeru chikatilo unnavaarukaaru.
meerandaru velugu sambandhulunu pagati sambandhulunai yunnaaru; manamu raatrivaaramu kaamu, chikativaaramukaamu.
kaavuna itharulavale nidrapoka melakuvagaa undi matthulamukaaka yundamu.
nidrapovuvaaru raatrivela nidrapovuduru, matthugaa unduvaaru raatrivela matthugaa unduru.
manamu pagativaaramai yunnaamu ganuka matthulamai yundaka, vishvaasa premalanu kavachamu, rakshananireekshanayanu shirastraana munu dharinchukondamu.
endukanagaa mana prabhuvaina yesu kreesthudvaaraa rakshanapondutake dhevudu manalanu niyaminchenu gaani ugrathapaalagutaku niyamimpaledu.
manamu melukoniyunnanu nidrapovuchunnanu thanathookooda jeevinchunimitthamu aayana manakoraku mruthipondhenu.
kaabatti meerippudu cheyuchunnattugaane yokaninokadu aadarinchi yokanikokadu kshemaabhivruddhi kalugajeyudi.
mariyu sahodarulaaraa, meelo prayaasapaduchu prabhuvunandu meeku paivaaraiyundi meeku buddhi cheppuvaarini mannanachesi
vaari paninibatti vaarini premathoo mikkili ghanamugaa enchavalenani vedukonuchunnaamu; mariyu okanithoo nokadu samaadhaanamugaa undudi.

sahodarulaaraa, memu meeku bodhinchunadhi emanagaa akramamugaa naduchukonuvaariki buddhi cheppudi, dhairyamu chedinavaarini dairyaparachudi, balaheenulaku ootha niyyudi, andariyedala deergha shaanthamugalavaarai yundudi.
evadunu keedunaku prathikeedu evanikainanu cheyakunda choochukonudi;meeru okani yedala okadunu manushyulandari yedalanu ellappudu melainadaanini anusarinchi naduchukonudi.
ellappudunu santhooshamugaa undudi;
yedategaka praarthanacheyudi;
prathi vishayamunandunu kruthagnathaasthuthulu chellinchudi. eelaagu cheyuta yesukreesthunandu mee vishayamulo dhevuni chitthamu.
aatmanu aarpakudi.
pravachinchutanu nirlakshyamu cheyakudi.
samasthamunu pareekshinchi melainadaanini chepattudi.
prathi vidhamaina keedunakunu dooramugaa undudi.

samaadhaanakarthayagu dhevude mimmunu sampoornamugaa parishuddhaparachunu gaaka. mee aatmayu, jeevamunu shareeramunu mana prabhuvaina yesukreesthu raakadayandu nindaa rahi thamugaanu, sampoornamugaanu undunatlu kaapaadabadunu gaaka.
mimmunu piluchuvaadu nammakamainavaadu ganuka aalaagu cheyunu.
sahodarulaaraa, maakoraku praarthanacheyudi.
pavitramaina muddupettukoni sahodarulakandarikini vandhanamulu cheyudi.
sahodarulakandarikini yee patrika chadhivi vinipimpavalenani prabhuvupera meeku aana bettuchunnaanu.
mana prabhuvaina yesukreesthu krupa meeku thoodai yundunu gaaka.
